subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Comparar notícias e reportagens sobre um mesmo fato divulgadas em diferentes mídias, analisando as especificidades das mídias, os processos de (re)elaboração dos textos e a convergência das mídias em notícias ou reportagens multissemióticas.

components.description_pt: Comparar detalhes enfatizados em duas diferentes reportagens sobre o mesmo assunto
components.description_en: Compare the details emphasized across two different media accounts of the same subject
components.cc_component_description: Compare the details emphasized across two different media accounts of the same subject

components.description_pt: Analisar características específicas de cada meio em reportagens de notícia multissemióticas
components.description_en: Analyze specific characteristics of each medium in multisemiotic news stories
components.cc_component_description: Evaluate the advantages and limitations of each medium's portrayal of a subject

components.description_pt: Identificar processos de elaboração e reelaboração de textos em diferentes mídias
components.description_en: Identify processes of elaboration and re-elaboration of texts across different media
components.cc_component_description: Compare insights gained from different media formats and explain how each contributes uniquely to understanding a topic

components.description_pt: Reconhecer convergência de mídias em reportagens de notícia multissemióticas e relatórios
components.description_en: Recognize media convergence in multisemiotic news stories and reports

cc_matches.description: Analyze various accounts of a subject told in different mediums (e.g., a person's life story in both print and multimedia), determining which details are emphasized in each account.

Compare and contrast a text to an audio, video, or multimedia version of the text, analyzing each medium's portrayal of the subject (e.g., how the delivery of a speech affects the impact of the words).
Integrate and evaluate multiple sources of information presented in diverse formats and media (e.g., quantitative data, video, multimedia) in order to address a question or solve a problem.
